artists.biography:
Baxter Dury (born 18 December 1971, Wingrave, Buckinghamshire, England) is an English indie musician, currently signed to Rough Trade Records. He is the son of Ian Dury, and as a five-year-old he appeared on the front cover of Ian's LP New Boots and Panties!!. He left school at the age of fourteen. He has had a 'Record of the Week' in NME with Oscar Brown EP in 2002. He has one son, Kosmo Korda Dury (born 2002) whose mother is the granddaughter of Zoltan Korda.
More recently, Dury has signed a new recording contract with Parlophone.

perplexity.description:
Prince of Tears is the fifth studio album by English musician Baxter Dury, released in October 2017 through PIAS and Heavenly Recordings. Musically, the album continues Dury’s signature blend of rock with elements of post-punk, lo-fi indie, and spoken-word delivery, characterized by shuffling basslines, minimalistic arrangements, and a wry, sardonic lyrical style. The record is noted for its intimate, confessional tone, with Dury exploring themes of personal vulnerability, relationships, and urban life, all delivered with his trademark blend of bleakness and warmth.

Within Baxter Dury’s discography, Prince of Tears stands as one of his most ambitious and emotionally direct works, marking a progression from his earlier, more detached persona toward a more open and introspective approach. The album received positive critical attention, earning an aggregate score of 78/100 on Metacritic and 7.2/10 on AnyDecentMusic?, with outlets like Loud and Quiet and Under the Radar awarding it 7/10. Commercially, it reached number 49 on the UK Albums Chart and number 46 on the French Albums Chart, reflecting a steady reception among fans and critics alike.
